prediction.band_note: Middle 50% of REALISED returns on the training split, conditional on the class the model predicts - a description of the training distribution, not a confidence interval for this path.
prediction.curve_note: The regression head is worse than predicting no change at every horizon (measured on held-out test data). The flat dotted line is that baseline; the two nearly coincide, which is the honest read.
prediction.caveat: MEASURED: the regression head is WORSE than predicting the mean at every horizon - read 'expected' as an output, not a forecast. The direction head is the part that carries the signal.

prediction_history.note: Every projection this dashboard has recorded, one point per candle, averaged over the windows that named it. Breaks are periods when nothing was running - the model made no call there. Stored in models/predictions.db.

regime.baseline_note: the two activity classes are 50/50 by construction on train, so 0.50 is the number to beat
